title: Matched space-time reconciliation of the high-resolution Richards Reference
scientific_question: At R512 and R1024, is main-history temporal transaction error smaller than the remaining R512-R1024 spatial difference when the exact same B14 dynamic prescribed-head history is represented at finer transaction intervals and re-aggregated to the original hydrological observation windows?

physical_workload.forcing_switch_times: identical in physical time to C5A/C5E
physical_workload.initial_state: identical effective-saturation state and unchanged two-interval seed route

T4.failure_rule: retain exact qualification failure and continue C5F without any numerical-policy retuning

aggregation_contract.T2: sum each pair of consecutive bottom outward exchanges and divide by 0.0008 d
aggregation_contract.T4: sum each four consecutive bottom outward exchanges and divide by 0.0008 d
aggregation_contract.reason: All space-time comparisons are made on the same physical hydrological window; refined transaction boundaries are not mistaken for new hydrological observations.

adjudication.TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_AT_R1024: T4 qualifies and R1024 T2-T4 RMSE is smaller than R1024 T1-T2 RMSE.
adjudication.TEMPORAL_SUBDOMINANT_TO_SPATIAL: At matched T2 scale, R1024 T2-T4 RMSE is smaller than the R512_T2-R1024_T2 spatial RMSE.
adjudication.TEMPORAL_NOT_SUBDOMINANT: At matched T2 scale, R1024 T2-T4 RMSE is greater than or equal to the R512_T2-R1024_T2 spatial RMSE.
adjudication.interpretation: These are relative error-scale statements, not hydrological fidelity thresholds and not application acceptance.
